routeError.title: Something went wrong on this screen
routeError.description: The rest of the app keeps working. You can go back home or copy the details for support.

physical.title: Physical controller
physical.hint: A physical controller is using Windows index {{slot}}. It is not from PadGaming.

nearby.title: Nearby on the network
nearby.empty: No phone with PadGaming open nearby.

confirm.revokeBody: The device is disconnected now and can’t connect again without pairing.
confirm.forgetBody: Its record and history are erased. To use it again, pair it again.

pair.title: Pair a new device
pair.description: Open PadGaming on your phone and scan the code or type the PIN.
pair.pinHelp: In the app, choose “Enter PIN” and type these numbers.
pair.fingerprintHelp: Check that it matches the one on your phone.

empty.title: No devices yet
empty.description: Open PadGaming on your phone, on the same Wi-Fi network, and pair with a QR code or PIN.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.importFailed: That file is not a valid profile.
profiles.none: No profiles. Create one to start.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.body: The profile is deleted for good.
confirmDelete.bodyInUse: It is in use: {{devices}} device(s) have it as default and {{slots}} controller(s) are using it right now. They switch to the Default profile.

confirmRestore.title: Restore the Default profile?
confirmRestore.body: The Default profile goes back to the original. Your other profiles don’t change.

save.readOnly: Built-in profile: duplicate it to edit.

panel.empty: Select a button, trigger or stick on the controller to adjust it.
panel.pad: X360 controller. Pick an element to edit.

rumble.title: Vibration
rumble.hint: The vibration the game asks for reaches the phone with this intensity. Above 100% it saturates at the maximum.

chart.label: Latency chart: RTT p50 and p95 for each controller

tips.title: Tips
tips.loss: P{{slot}}: move closer to the router or use the 5 GHz network.
tips.jitter: P{{slot}}: turn off Wi-Fi battery saving on the phone.
tips.rtt: P{{slot}}: close apps that use the network or change the Wi-Fi channel.

summary.line: RTT {{rtt}} ms (p95 {{p95}} ms), jitter {{jitter}} ms, loss {{loss}}%, {{rate}} packets/s, server {{processing}} ms

empty.title: No controllers connected
empty.description: Connect a phone to see the latency live.

serverName.label: Server name
serverName.hint: The name the phone shows. Empty uses the computer name. Takes effect the next time the app opens.

autostart.label: Start with Windows
autostart.hint: Opens PadGaming when you sign in to Windows.

startMinimized.label: Start minimized
startMinimized.hint: Opens straight to the tray, without showing the window.

closeToTray.label: Closing goes to the tray
closeToTray.hint: When you close the window the app keeps running so phones stay connected.

requireApproval.label: Ask before accepting new devices
requireApproval.hint: A new phone only joins after you allow it.

ports.label: Ports
ports.hint: Control channel (TCP), input (UDP) and discovery (UDP). New ports take effect after the app restarts.

interfaces.label: Network interfaces
interfaces.hint: This PC’s addresses on the local network, to connect a phone manually.

testConnection.label: Test connection
testConnection.hint: Checks that the control channel and discovery answer on the local network.

firewall.label: Windows Firewall
firewall.hint: PadGaming needs inbound rules so the phone can reach the PC.

driver.label: Virtual controller driver (ViGEmBus)
driver.hint: Creates the Xbox 360 controllers that games see.

defaultProfile.label: Default profile for new devices
defaultProfile.hint: The mapping a new phone gets until you pick another for it.

sendRate.label: Suggested send rate
sendRate.hint: How many times per second the phone sends the controller state. 250 Hz is more precise; 125 Hz saves battery and network.

reservation.label: Slot reservation time
reservation.hint: How long the controller waits for the phone to come back after a drop.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Dark, light or the same as the system.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.hint: The color of buttons, selections and focus.

transparency.label: Transparency
transparency.hint: Glass effect (Mica or Acrylic) on the window.

clearHistory.label: Clear history
clearHistory.hint: Erases the list of connections, disconnections and refusals.

regenerateIdentity.label: Regenerate the server identity
regenerateIdentity.hint: Creates a new certificate. Every paired phone stops recognizing this PC and must pair again.

logs.label: Logs folder
logs.hint: Where the diagnostic records are kept.

updates.label: Updates
updates.hint: Look for a new PadGaming version.

diagnostic.label: Export diagnostics
diagnostic.hint: Bundles the last days of logs and system info into a file for support, without tokens or keys.

licenses.label: Third-party licenses
licenses.hint: Third-party components PadGaming uses, including ViGEmBus.

notifyConnections.label: Phone connections
notifyConnections.hint: Tells you when a phone connects, reconnects or disconnects. A burst of reconnections becomes a single notice.

notifyPairing.label: Pairing
notifyPairing.hint: Tells you about pairings, approval requests and refused connections.

notifyDriver.label: Virtual controller driver
notifyDriver.hint: Tells you when the driver stops working and when it’s back.

notifySkipFullscreen.label: Quiet during full-screen games
notifySkipFullscreen.hint: No notice appears while a game fills the whole screen.

help.label: Help
help.hint: Getting started, pairing, mapping, latency and troubleshooting.

ports.duplicate: The three ports must be different.
ports.pending: The new ports take effect after the app restarts.

firewall.ok: The firewall does not block PadGaming.
firewall.notApplicable: This system doesn’t use the Windows Firewall.
firewall.public: One of your networks is set to public, and the firewall blocks the phone on it.

clear.title: Clear the history?
clear.body: The connection list is erased for good.

regenerate.title: Regenerate the server identity?
regenerate.body: Every paired phone is forgotten and must pair again, and the app must restart. This can’t be undone.
regenerate.restartBody: The new identity only applies after a restart. The phones were disconnected.

welcome.title: Your phone is the controller
welcome.description: PadGaming turns your phone into an Xbox 360 controller for Windows games. Let’s get everything ready in a few steps.

driver.title: Virtual controller driver
driver.what: Games only see real controllers. ViGEmBus is a free driver that creates virtual Xbox 360 controllers, and it’s how PadGaming delivers what the phone sends.
driver.outdated: The installed driver is old ({{found}}). It needs version {{required}} or newer.
driver.stopped: The driver is installed but stopped. Restart the PC or the ViGEmBus service.
driver.afterInstall: After installing, come back here: PadGaming notices on its own.
driver.warning: Without the driver, PadGaming can’t create controllers for games.

network.title: Network
network.description: The phone needs to reach this PC over the local network (Wi-Fi).
network.name: Name
network.noAddress: No local network. Connect the PC to Wi-Fi or a wired network.
network.firewallOk: The firewall lets the phone connect.
network.firewallBlocked: The Windows Firewall is blocking PadGaming.
network.notApplicable: This system doesn’t use the Windows Firewall.
network.cancelled: The administrator permission was declined. You can try again.
network.public: One of your networks is set to public, and the phone can’t connect on it.

connect.title: Connect your phone
connect.description: Open PadGaming on your phone, on the same Wi-Fi network, and scan the code or type the PIN.
connect.getApp: Don’t have the app yet? It’s coming soon to the Play Store.
connect.nearbyEmpty: No phone with PadGaming open nearby yet.
connect.successHint: Controller P1 is already responding. Press a button on the phone.

done.title: All set
done.tipWifi: Use 5 GHz Wi-Fi for less delay.
done.tipTray: Closing the window leaves PadGaming in the tray; right-click the icon to see the controllers.

tray.hint: PadGaming keeps running in the tray.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, send the diagnostics.
errors.invalid_input: A value you entered is not valid.
errors.unsupported: This feature is not available on this system.
errors.not_found: I couldn't find the requested item. It may have been removed.
errors.builtin_profile: The Default profile belongs to the app and can't be edited or deleted. Duplicate it to customize.
errors.import_invalid: The file is not a valid PadGaming profile.
errors.no_network: No local network found. Connect the PC to Wi-Fi or a wired network.
